description: Look up one brand's public creator program: how creators apply or pitch, the program summary, what the brand sells, and the link to its BravoDM program page. Covers only the brands with public program pages at bravodm.com/brands, from the same catalog records those pages render. Pass a brand name or its BravoDM slug.

brand.description: Brand name (for example Caraway) or slug (caraway).
